## Release Model

The current tagged release is `v0.6.2`. This page is generated from the
ordered git tag set and the commit subjects contained in each tagged range.

For release `r` with tag `\tau_r`, previous tag `\tau_{r-1}`, and commit set
`\mathcal{C}_r`, the page computes:

$$
\mathcal{C}_r = \{ c \mid c \in (\tau_{r-1}, \tau_r] \}
$$

$$
N_r = |\mathcal{C}_r|, \qquad
\Delta_r = \max\left(1, d_r - d_{r-1}\right), \qquad
\rho_r = \frac{N_r}{\Delta_r}
$$

$$
L_r(\ell) = \sum_{c \in \mathcal{C}_r} \mathbf{1}[\ell \in \lambda(c)]
$$

where `N_r` is the tagged commit count, `\Delta_r` is the elapsed day span
between releases with a one-day floor, and `\rho_r` is the resulting commit
density. The label score `L_r(\ell)` counts how often a release is associated
with a classification label `\ell` after keyword bucketing commit subjects into
Docs, Fixes, Features, Release, and Maintenance groups.
